request.initial_prompt: O worthiness of nature! breed of greatness! Cowards father cowards and base things sire base. Nature hath meal and bran, contempt and grace. I'm not their father; yet who this should be Doth miracle itself, lov'd before me.— 'Tis the ninth hour o' th' morn.

raw_segments.text: O worthiness of nature! breed of greatness! Cowards father cowards and base things sire base. Nature hath meal and bran, contempt and grace. I'm not their father, yet who this should be Doth miracle itself, lov'd before me.—
O, Worthyness of Nature, Breed of Greatness, Cowards, Father Cowards, and Base Things,
Sire Base. Nature hath meal and bran, Contempt and grace. I'm not their Father, yet who
this should be doth Miracle itself, Loved before me.
Tease the ninth hour O, T.H. Morn.
